title: Arkret Principal Locator
description: Signed online locator returned from a holder-controlled Principal Server locator ref. It asserts the invite address used for private invite delivery; it is not a Realm membership grant and not a member_delivery_binding.

subject_id.description: Principal DID of the invite recipient. v1 core defaults principal DIDs to did:webvh; did:web is only valid for principal identity when an explicit deployment profile or resolver policy allows it.

recipient_service_id.description: Principal Server service DID that accepts invite delivery for subject_id.

recipient_service_kind.description: v1 only allows Principal Server invite delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.

expires_at.description: Time after which the locator MUST NOT be used to initiate invite delivery.

locator_ref_digest.description: Digest of the private locator ref material. The raw locator token MUST NOT appear in durable Realm events.

delivery_modes.description: Invite-delivery capability hints only; join-time member_delivery_binding is still materialized by Realm policy.

display_hint.description: UI-only display hint. It is not identity authority and MUST NOT be used for authorization.

proofs.description: At minimum contains recipient_service_acceptance. High-assurance deployments SHOULD also require subject_locator_authorization.

proof.description: Detached proof over canonical_json(principal_locator_without_proofs). proof.payload_digest MUST equal that canonical payload digest.

locator_token.description: Opaque base64url locator token with at least 128 bits of entropy. It SHOULD be a server-side handle and MUST NOT plaintext-encode subject_id, recipient_service_id, expiry, policy state, or other invitee-identifying material. It MUST be sent in the JSON body, never in URL path or query string.

ttl_seconds.description: Requested locator lifetime. The Principal Server MAY shorten it but MUST NOT exceed the v1 one-hour ceiling.

one_time_use.description: When true, the first successful resolve atomically consumes the locator.

ttl_seconds.description: Requested replacement-locator lifetime. When omitted, preserve the old locator's granted lifetime (old expires_at minus old issued_at). The Principal Server MAY shorten it but MUST NOT exceed the v1 one-hour ceiling.

one_time_use.description: Whether the first successful resolve atomically consumes the replacement locator. When omitted, preserve the old locator's one_time_use value.

display_hint.description: Replacement display hint. When omitted, preserve the old hint; null explicitly clears it.

locator_token.description: Fresh opaque bearer secret generated from at least 192 bits of CSPRNG entropy and returned exactly once. Clients MUST keep it out of logs, analytics, caches, and ordinary durable local state; an explicit user-directed out-of-band handoff is permitted and inherits the token's TTL and revocation risks.

locator_id.description: Non-secret administrative identifier used only on the authenticated self surface.

display_hint.description: UI-only display hint. It is not identity authority and MUST NOT be used for authorization.
